items.q: What is the difference between review and optimization?
items.a: A review tells you what to change. Optimization makes the changes for you while keeping your own experience and details.

items.q: Will my project details stay the same?
items.a: Yes. We improve wording, structure and competency coverage without changing the facts of your work.
